newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent trades 24 cents off amid bearish APIs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent trades 24 cents off amid bearish APIs.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures extends its losses late Wednesday, weighed down by weak IPE gas oil futures and bearish sentiment caused by American Petroleum Institute (API) figures, brokers said.
January gas oil futures levels which eased $5.25 per tonne have dragged Brent levels down with it, said a broker.

Brokers said bearish API figures have compounded the weakness. The API statistics showed that crude oil stocks rose 324,000 barrels, distillates stocks climbed by over two million barrels and gasoline were up by almost six million barrels.
January was last traded at $23.05, 24 cents off from its last quote on London's IPE at $23.29 and nine cents off from is its intraday high. A total of 128 lots changed hands.
February was bid/asked at $22.56/$22.66 against its last close at $22.76.
NYMEX January crude on the after-hours ACCESS fell 26 cents below its last official close to be quoted at $24.16.
